title: A sixth-cumulant-canceling three-point seed locally beats Rademacher at matched negative fourth defect

comparison.three_point_seed: p_*=(15+sqrt(105))/60; X_*=0 with probability 1-p_* and X_*=+-p_*^(-1/2) with probability p_*/2 each.
comparison.strict_local_order: j_R(q)-j_*(q)=(4/15)q^3+O(q^(7/2))>0 for every sufficiently small q>0.
comparison.scope_guard: This is a pointwise weak-channel comparison at matched covariance and fourth defect. It neither proves a global finite-t seed optimizer nor strict inequality between the fully optimized field envelopes.
